current_evidence: No published local validation list was found. The Development Management index and the 'Submitting a Planning Application' page (posted 19 Oct 2026) link to no local list or checklist, site-restricted searches found none, and the MHCLG planning.data.gov.uk local-area-requirements record for Stevenage (entry date 2026-10-16) points to the same page with the note 'Couldn't find any sort of checklist'.

issues.detail: The status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is wrong. The page loads normally and can be read. It just contains no local validation list. All 18 app_type rows repeat the misleading 'local list link found but not readable this run' note, when they should say that no local list is published and only national requirements apply.
issues.evidence: The page is live ('Posted on 19 Oct 2026') and covers Planning Portal submission, the OS site location plan and the fees calculator.

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' is the general 'Submitting a Planning Application' guidance page, not a local validation list. The council does not appear to publish a local list. The column should say that no local list exists rather than presenting this page as the list.
issues.evidence: planning.data.gov.uk local-area-requirements:stevenage-local-area-requirements, documentation-url = this page, notes: 'Couldn't find any sort of checklist'.

issues.detail: The page's own submission rules were not recorded: applications lacking required supporting information or the correct fee are made invalid, and from 1 January 2026 emailed or paper applications carry a £120 (inc VAT) service charge on top of the planning fee. These are process and fee points rather than local list items, but the workbook could note them.
issues.evidence: Submitting a Planning Application page: '£120 (including VAT) service charge' for emailed/paper applications from 1 January 2026.

issues.detail: The URL came from a third-party directory (planninggeek.co.uk) and was not verified. The 'Planning page' field is only the council homepage.
issues.evidence: reference_row 'URL source': 'planninggeek.co.uk directory (third-party; not verified on this run)'; 'Planning page': https://www.stevenage.gov.uk

summary: Grokbot's link works and is the council's general submission page, not a local validation list. Stevenage appears to publish no local list (MHCLG's dataset says the same), so the '(none)' rows are right in substance. The 'blocked/404/login' status and the 'not readable' notes are wrong.
